persons.name: Bora Özkent
persons.digest:
He made a video on why he stays away from **China** stocks: according to Bora Özkent, Chinese companies' sales are growing but profits are not (industrial profit +0.6%), companies are heavily indebted and investor protection is weak; the stocks are cheap, but for a reason. That is why he prefers the tech-heavy **US** market. In the morning bulletin he said earnings season opens with the banks and that Wednesday's CPI is the key data point this week; he read the drop in oil after Trump's diesel deal with Russia as positive for markets.

On AI, he said **Nvidia** is spreading its risk by investing in open-source models, explained rising GPU demand despite falling token prices through the Jevons paradox, and called the bubble debates pointless. He added that the Senate will be the deciding factor for markets in the US midterms.

items.title: Neden Çin Hisselerinden Uzak Duruyorum?
items.summary: Bora Özkent says he does not invest in Chinese stocks and will not start, stressing that choosing the country matters for company performance. According to MSCI data, $10,000 over 10 years became $41,523 in the US and $14,133 in China; annual return was 15.30% vs 3.52%, volatility 15.59% vs 23.95%, Sharpe ratio 0.84 vs 0.16. In 2025 China's industrial value added grew 5.9% while industrial profit barely grew; companies sell at discounts and fail to earn despite state support (cash support of about 2% of GDP). Because loss-making firms do not go under, capital allocation is distorted; private-sector debt is 142% of GDP in China vs 72% in the US, and extended public debt is around 305%. Deflation prevents debts from eroding, the VIE structure makes shareholder rights unclear, and the authoritarian state carries sudden-crackdown risk. On valuation China is at about half the price (P/E 13.03 vs 25.37; dividend yield 2.43% vs 1.11%), but Bora Özkent says it could stay cheap for a long time. He says he could change his mind if capital allocation is liberalized and unprofitable firms are weeded out; until then he would only look at short-term trades.

assets.note: Comparing China and US companies, he cites Amazon vs Alibaba as an example of Chinese firms being much cheaper; he still does not buy Chinese stocks.

items.title: Borsalarda Bilanço ve Enflasyon Heyecanı
items.summary: According to Bora Özkent, the S&P 500 closed Friday up 0.59% and ended the week up 1.2%, while the Russell 2000 fell because rates have not come down. Markets are slightly positive in early trading as oil eased after Trump's diesel purchase from Russia and 'energy ceasefire' claim; neither side has confirmed the deal. For Wednesday's CPI, monthly headline is expected at 0.53%, core at 0.20%, with annual 3.6% headline and 2.4% core; since wages (3.1%) lag inflation (3.4%), he does not expect inflation to surge lastingly, though wealthy households' spending keeps consumption alive. The S&P 500 gained 11.9% on average in rising-rate years and 11.8% in falling-rate years; AI infrastructure investment continues regardless of rates. JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and Bank of America report this week; he expects slight deterioration in credit cards and consumer loans but no major problem. He reads Nvidia's talks to acquire Reflection AI as a risk-spreading move; he says GPU rental prices are rising while token prices fall, and that overcapacity and bubble debates are pointless. He expects Trump to lose the House in the midterms and says markets would like it if he keeps the Senate.

assets.note: He reads the Reflection AI acquisition talks as a smart move spreading risk across open and closed models; says GPU demand will rise.

persons.digest: WallStDiaries opened the week noting that US stocks closed a record week higher (S&P 500 +1.2%), the 10-year yield at 5.24% is at its highest since 2002, and Brent crude rose above 105 dollars on Houthi attacks. September CPI on Wednesday is expected to accelerate to 3.7% headline from 3.4%; a hotter print could strengthen tightening expectations before the October 28 Fed meeting. During the day China's CXMT progress in memory architecture hit **Micron**, **SK Hynix** and **Samsung** shares; **Broadcom** CEO Hock Tan said the biggest constraint is access to capital, not chips; and **Lumentum** was reported sold out through early 2029. The feed also carried the **IREN**-Anthropic cloud deal, **IonQ**'s Elisity acquisition and **Strategy**'s purchase of 250 Bitcoin.

items.title: Günaydın: piyasa özeti ve öncü göstergeler
items.summary: US stocks closed a record week higher; the S&P 500 ended the week up 1.2% and the 10-year yield rose to 5.24% (a 2002 high of 5.31% earlier in the week). Oil, strong growth, sticky inflation, a hawkish Fed and high public debt are cited as keeping yields up. At the close the S&P 500 was 7,811.54, Nasdaq 100 30,883.14, Dow 51,654.95; Bitcoin 83,506, gold 4,201.39, Brent 104.74. Korea was down 3.65% in leading indicators.

assets.note: Listed at 83,506, down 0.09%, in the market summary.
Listed at 104.74 in the market summary.

items.title: 12-16 Ekim ABD veri takvimi: TÜFE kritik
items.summary: The key data point of the week is September CPI on Wednesday; annual headline is expected to rise from 3.4% to 3.7% on energy, with core at 2.5% (previous 2.4%). With the 10-year yield at its highest since 2002, a print above expectations could strengthen tightening expectations before the October 28 Fed meeting. The calendar also has Waller, the Fed Beige Book, retail sales, PPI and Fed Chair Warsh's Friday speech.

items.title: Brent petrol 105 doları aştı
items.summary: As Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia intensified supply concerns, Brent briefly rose above 105 dollars; high energy costs are reviving rate pressure and stagflation risk.

assets.note: Rose above 105 dollars on Houthi attacks.

items.title: Trump: seçim öncesi İran'a yeni saldırı yok
items.summary: Trump announced no new military strike on Iran before the November 3 midterms, said talks with Tehran are productive, and that the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz will continue; this is said to have eased short-term tension in oil markets.

items.title: Yardeni: 10 yıllık faiz %6 olursa çatlaklar
items.summary: Ed Yardeni says a rapid climb of the US 10-year yield to 6% could create serious cracks in the financial system, lock up credit markets and hit growth hard; the large budget deficit and AI borrowing are pushing yields higher.

items.title: Hock Tan: en büyük kısıt sermaye
items.summary: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan says the biggest obstacle in AI infrastructure will be access to capital and financing cost, not chips or power; he says compute demand will stay strong through 2030 and that Broadcom has talked with Wall Street consortia about providing billions in debt financing to its customers.

assets.note: According to the CEO the biggest constraint is capital; Broadcom is talking to banks about debt financing for customers.

items.title: CXMT bellek devlerini salladı
items.summary: China's CXMT announcing a major step in its 4F² memory architecture and a new server-memory product range raised competition concerns; Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung shares fell.

assets.note: Micron shares fell after the CXMT announcement.

items.title: Lumentum 2029 başına kadar dolu
items.summary: Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston said optoelectronic capacity is sold out through early 2029; the company expects to be unable to meet 70% of demand in some optical products next year and 30% through 2028. Wedbush says this is positive for raw-material and fab partners.

assets.note: Capacity sold through early 2029; much of demand cannot be met.

items.title: Anthropic-IREN çok yıllı bulut anlaşması
items.summary: Anthropic is reported to have signed a multiyear cloud services contract with IREN to expand GPU capacity (another source says the report is not yet confirmed).

assets.note: A multiyear cloud deal with Anthropic was reported.

items.title: Strategy 250 Bitcoin daha aldı
items.summary: Strategy bought 250 Bitcoin between Oct 5-11 at an average of 86,194 dollars; total holdings are 848,250 BTC at an average cost of 75,444 dollars. 21 million dollars of the purchase was financed by MSTR share sales.

Strategy keeps buying; a separate post noted the 13/34 week EMA crossed up for the first time in 3.5 years.

persons.name: Tunç Şatıroğlu
persons.digest: Tunç Şatıroğlu gave clear levels for semiconductors: on Friday he had said sell below 610 on **SMH**, today he flagged 600 as critical support; if the rally continues buy, if it slips back below 610 sell. On Europe, he said political risk has risen because of scenarios in France and the possibility of AfD in Germany, and that the US should be preferred for investment.

items.title: SMH: 610 altında sat, 600 kritik destek
items.summary: Tunç Şatıroğlu recalls saying on Friday to sell below 610 and today that 600 is critical support; SMH fell to oversold territory and turned up from 609, and he says if the rise continues it is a buy, if it slips below 610 again it is a sell.

assets.note: Buy above 610, sell below 610; 600 is critical support.

items.title: Fransa ve Almanya siyasi riski
items.summary: Tunç Şatıroğlu says that if the radical left wins in France there could be a moratorium, if the far right wins there could be rapid rate cuts, and either way France would need rescuing by the ECB; if AfD takes power in Germany it might want to leave. He says political risk in Europe has risen and the US should be preferred for investment.

persons.name: FinancewithIzzy
persons.digest:
FinancewithIzzy read today's AI selloff through four themes: China's CXMT new DRAM design pressured **Micron** (though he stressed HBM competition is unproven and **Sandisk**'s core business is NAND), **Broadcom** CEO Hock Tan flagged access to capital, optical stocks (**Lumentum**, **Coherent**, **Applied Opto**) fell sharply on high expectations, and oil plus bond yields made AI stocks more sensitive. His overall read is selective risk reduction within tech.

He also wrote that **Nvidia**'s revenue grew 106% and EPS 128% last quarter yet the stock is up only about 30% in 2026, with the multiple around 15 on 2027 earnings; if the market re-rates it at 30x it could theoretically double by end-2027, though that is no guarantee.

items.title: AI satışının dört nedeni
items.summary: FinancewithIzzy reads the sharp decline as: (1) CXMT's plan to ship server memory with a new DRAM design by year-end is pressuring Micron, but this does not mean the same competitiveness in HBM; (2) Broadcom CEO Hock Tan expects compute demand to exceed supply over the next two years while questioning the economic return of financing it longer term; (3) the sharp selling in Lumentum, Coherent and Applied Opto reflects high expectations being priced in, with Lumentum falling despite a new optical interconnect demo; (4) rising oil and bond yields raise inflation worry and financing costs. He interprets optical and memory stocks being sold while Microsoft and Meta rose as selective risk reduction and says he will watch orders, deliveries, margins and cash flow in earnings.

assets.note: CXMT's new DRAM design is one concrete reason for the pressure on Micron.
Hock Tan flagged access to capital and the economic return on financing.
The stock fell sharply despite a new optical interconnect demo; expectations were priced in.
Says it cannot be assessed on the same grounds as an optical company or memory makers.
Among tech stocks that rose today together with Microsoft.
Rising oil is increasing inflation concerns.

items.title: NVIDIA 2027'de ikiye katlanabilir mi?
items.summary: FinancewithIzzy writes that Nvidia's revenue grew 106% and EPS 128% last quarter, yet the stock is up only about 30% in 2026 and trades at about 15x 2027 earnings. If the market re-rates it at 30x, a doubling by end-2027 is theoretically possible, but he adds it is no guarantee and valuation will be the key question.

assets.note: Thinks the growth story is not over; multiple is low on 2027 estimates, but valuation now matters more.

persons.name: wallstengine
persons.digest:
Wall St Engine tied today's semiconductor selloff to China's CXMT progress and Hock Tan's cautious comments on AI investment: **KOSPI** fell as much as 7.4% intraday, **Samsung** dropped 7.7% and **SK Hynix** 8.8%; CXMT has not yet shown it can produce the technology at scale. **Cerebras** is down about 58% since its IPO, hit a new low, and about 19.4 million shares come off lockup on Oct. 14.

On the news side, **Nvidia** opened Vera Rubin rack designs at OCP, **Meta** launched its Muse Wonder models, **IonQ** is buying Elisity for 1.3 billion dollars, and **IREN** was reported to have signed a cloud deal with Anthropic (IREN has not confirmed). Deutsche Bank upgraded **AST SpaceMobile** to Buy with a 93 dollar target.

items.title: KOSPI gün içinde %7,4 düştü
items.summary: KOSPI fell 7.4% intraday; Samsung dropped 7.7% and SK Hynix 8.8%. China's CXMT progress fueled memory competition and pricing-power concerns, and Hock Tan's cautious AI investment comments added pressure. Foreigners net sold 8.46 trillion won in October through Oct. 12; CXMT has not yet shown it can manufacture the technology at scale.

assets.note: Fell 7.4% intraday on CXMT and Hock Tan comments.

items.title: Cerebras halka arzından beri %58 düştü

items.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin raf tasarımlarını açtı
items.summary: Nvidia opened Vera Rubin rack designs via the MGX architecture at OCP; Meta is adopting Spectrum-6 switches, a 400Gb/s-per-lane USFP optical module is planned with Cisco, and Google's Falcon Transport will be supported on ConnectX-10.

items.title: Meta Muse Wonder modellerini tanıttı
items.summary: Meta introduced the agent- and coding-focused Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full models, trained at its Prometheus data center and available via the Meta Model API and Muse Code.

items.summary: AST SpaceMobile rose about 4.6% at the open after Deutsche Bank upgraded it to Buy with a 93 dollar target; BlueBird 14-16 are at Cape Canaveral and the FCC authorized 900 MHz testing through Nov. 8.

items.title: IonQ Elisity'yi 1,3 milyar dolara alıyor
items.summary: IonQ is acquiring cybersecurity firm Elisity in an all-stock deal worth up to 1.3 billion dollars including up to 150 million in performance-based payments.

items.title: Anthropic-IREN anlaşması iddiası
items.summary: According to The Information Anthropic signed a multiyear cloud deal with IREN; it suggests the unnamed 'leading frontier AI lab' IREN disclosed in August could be Anthropic, but IREN has not confirmed the link.

persons.name: jrouldz
persons.digest:
jrouldz said he began a 'reverse-DCA' (gradual selling) strategy on **Palantir** today: at a 500 billion dollar market cap and 80x sales, locking in some gains can't hurt; he says shares bought at 7 are up about 2800%, that it will be higher in the 2030s but the best gains have probably already happened. On **IonQ**'s Elisity deal he said the dilution stings but it fits the ecosystem strategically and the price move roughly equals the implied dilution.

He complained that small speculative stocks are bleeding because of the rate environment, called **TMC** a binary bet on regulatory approvals with a public hearing tomorrow, and wrote that he likes **Micron** fundamentally but won't buy at the new price level.

items.title: PLTR'de reverse-DCA başlıyor
items.summary: jrouldz says he began his 'reverse-DCA' strategy in Palantir, that at a 500 billion dollar market cap and 80x sales locking in some gains can't hurt, especially in this environment where his small speculative positions are being crushed. He adds that shares bought at 7 are up 2800% and that the best gains have most likely already happened.

assets.note: Began gradual selling at a 500 billion dollar market cap and 80x sales; thinks it can be higher in the 2030s but the best gains are behind.

items.title: IonQ-Elisity: seyrelme acı ama strateji uyumlu
items.summary: jrouldz says the dilution in IonQ's Elisity deal stings existing shareholders, the acquisition fits the ecosystem being built, today's price move roughly equals the implied dilution, and the price looks high relative to the prior Oxford Ionics deal but not relative to other cybersecurity companies. He adds that anyone viewing it as merely buying revenue is clueless.

assets.note: Despite painful dilution it fits the long-term ecosystem strategy; the position is among his largest.

items.title: TMC: düzenleyici onaya bağlı ikili bahis
items.summary: jrouldz notes the relentless selling in small speculative companies, says TMC has a public hearing tomorrow, expects angry reactions from environmentalists, and that the company is essentially a binary bet on regulatory approvals.

assets.note: Public hearing tomorrow; a binary bet on regulatory approvals.

items.title: Micron: temelde iyi ama yeni fiyattan almam
items.summary: jrouldz says he briefly owned Micron, finds it great fundamentally, but that buying at the new price level goes against his principle since it traded much lower for so many years.

assets.note: Seen as fundamentally strong but not bought at the new price level.
